listings.remarks: First time ever on the market, this charming fully detached 1919 Parkside/Sunset garden cottage holds a century of rich local history—rumored to be hand-built by its original owner, Otto, when the neighborhood was still rolling sand dunes, and cherished within the same family for 107 years.
